content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician cum Research Assistant) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician cum Research Assistant) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support-I post is scheduled for 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available for the Project Technical Support-I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician cum Research Assistant) position at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 10th grade with a DMLT and two years of experience, or a B.Sc. degree with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000/- plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-In Interview. A Screening/Scrutiny Test may also be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, 342005.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is prior online application required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview, so no prior online application is required.
